note: What each build input resolved to. The Dockerfile carries the request; this file carries the artifact, and scripts/check_pins.sh fails when the two disagree. The apt rows record the suite their version came from, because a package and its library move together inside one suite. Move a pin with scripts/check_pins.sh --bump --remote --write.

pins.move: retag: bump the tag in base.dockerfile, then --bump --remote --write records the new index digest
